violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW STEAK OVER COOKED LAMB GYRO IN THE ONE DOOR UPR ON THE COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. THE FOODS WERE RE-LOCATED.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 165F for a stationary rack single temperature machine. The thermostat read @TEMPERATURE@. OBSERVED THE HIGH TEMP DISH MACHINE AT 143 DEGREES F AFTER RUNNING A FEW CYCLES.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. PIC WILL DISCONTINUE USE OF THE DISH MACHINE AND CALL TECHNICIAN FOR SERVICE. THE FACILITY WILL USE THE 3VAT SINK UNTIL DISHMACINE IS FIXED. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP TO ENSURE MACHINE IS FIXED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED A CHEMICAL SPRAY BOTTLE PLACED NEXT TO A CONTAINER OF FOOD IN THE DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CHEMICAL BOTTLE WAS RE-LOCATED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: OBSERVED UNWRAPPED SLICED HAM DIRECTLY EXPOSED TO PACKAGED FOODS IN THE ONE DOOR RIC ON THE COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. ITEMS WERE RELOCATED .

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: OBSERVED THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE SOILED TO THE SIGHT AND TOUCH.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC WILL DRAIN AND CLEAN/SANITIZE THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FLOORS, WALLS, AND CEILING TILES THROUGHOUT THE KITCHEN IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: the inside of the ice machine needs to be cleaned due to mold like substance build up.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PLEASE CLEAN THE INSIDE OF THE ICE MACHINE BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Tomato sauce in 5 gallon buckets were being stored on the floor while they cool.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE TOMATO SAUCE TO PREP TABLE TO CONTINUE TO COOL.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Multiple manufacturer containers were observed being reused for the storage of different foods.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE REASONING AS TO WHY SOME CONTAINERS MAY NOT BE REUSED TO STORE FOODS THAT DID NOT ORIGINALLY COME IN THEM. PIC WILL REPLACE ALL ONE-USE CONTAINERS BY THE TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are (missing, damaged): the gasket on the door to the walk-in refrigerator (1) needs to be replaced.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. PLEASE REPLACE THE GASKET ON THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR (1) DOOR SO IT PROPERLY SEALS.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Walk-in refrigerator (2) and the 2DR prep top on cook line are not working properly and can not hold a temp of 41 or below.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC WAS AWARE OF ISSUE WITH UNITS BEFORE INSPECTION. AT TIME OF INSPECTION NEITHER COOLER WAS BEING USED TO STORE FOODS. PIC HAD ALREADY CALLED IN A SERVICE REQUEST AND THE UNITS WERE BEING LOOKED AT FOR REPAIR THE DAY OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: multiple food items were being stored in non NSF containers.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT FOOD CANNOT BE STORED IN CONTAINERS THAT ARE NOT FOOD GRADE. PIC ORDERED APPROVED NSF CONTAINERS TO BEING REPLACING THE CONTAINERS THE RESTAURANT IS CURRENTLY USING. PIC SHOWED EHS THE INVOICE BEFORE THE END ON THE INSPECTION.
